name: St Joseph's Church (Bukit Timah)

rules.note: Mass in Honour of St Joseph

dated.title: Holy Hour for Vocations - last session for 2026

notes: Weekday Masses are held in the Chapel of St Joseph.

info.adoration: Adoration Room: Mon-Fri 7.00am-9.00pm, Sat 9.30am-7.00pm, Sun 8.00am-7.00pm, public holidays 8.00am-4.00pm. Holy Hour: first Friday 8.00pm in the Main Church.
info.confession: 15 minutes before all weekend Masses, in the Reconciliation Rooms in the church.
devotions: Garden Rosary: first Saturday, after the 5.30pm Sunset Mass
Grotto Rosary: every 13th of the month after the 6.30pm weekday Mass (weekdays only)
Blessing of Expectant Mothers: fourth Sunday of the month
good_to_know: The church gate is open 6.00am to 10.00pm.
The columbarium, Rosary Garden and Stations of the Cross are open 8.00am to 8.00pm daily.
The Media Centre (bookshop) is open Saturdays 4.30pm-7.00pm and Sundays 8.30am-1.00pm, and on the 2nd Sunday also 5.30pm-7.00pm.

events.title: Human Dignity & Development in the Era of AI
events.text: Fr David speaks at Catholic Centre on Tuesday 13 October on discerning the impact of AI in light of Pope Leo XIV's encyclical. Register at bit.ly/dignityoct.

events.title: Tuesday Morning Manna
events.text: Lectio: Prayer with Dr Tim Gray, Tuesday mornings at 11.05am in the St Joseph AVA Room. Join the WhatsApp community at tinyurl.com/TuesdayMorningManna.

events.title: Rest, Relish and Recharge
events.text: Days of reflection and prayer from 15 to 18 October, with rest and simple leisure activities, for self-discovery and emotional growth.

events.title: My Hands, His Plans: The Musical - tickets on sale
events.text: An original parish musical for the 180th anniversary, staged this November. Tickets ($10, or $50 premium view) go on sale from 17 October before and after weekend Masses at the St Joachim Room.

events.title: Crossroads Life Direction Retreat
events.text: A life direction retreat on 17-18 October to reconnect with your spiritual purpose and chart a meaningful path forward.

events.title: Small Catholic Communities dinner
events.text: Fellowship dinner with the Parish Priests on Saturday 17 October after the sunset Mass, for parishioners in their neighbourhood groups. Register at https://tinyurl.com/SCCGM2026.

events.title: Mysteries of the Rosary: The Joyful Mysteries
events.text: A video series on the Joyful Mysteries starting 20 October, every Tuesday night or Wednesday morning, in person and online via Zoom. Details via the Faith & Bible Reflections WhatsApp community: tinyurl.com/SJCBTFAB.

events.title: Prayer thru Music
events.text: An evening of prayer through music on Friday 30 October at 8pm.

events.title: Treasure #18 Retreat for Young Working Adults
events.text: A stay-in Catholic encounter retreat from 6 to 9 November for young working adults aged 21-35.

events.title: Bible in the City
events.text: A symposium on Monday 9 November organised by the Verbum Dei Missionaries, with keynote speakers and panelists, on rooting your life in the living Word of God.

events.title: Emmanuel
events.text: A morning of reflection on Friday 13 November at 10am for those approaching retirement or in their later years.
